summary: Complaints centre on Sorkha's sewer line that never started and road flooding, floodplain power cuts in Chhajarsi and Chotpur, and VIP-movement jams in Noida city, while appreciation focuses on the Sector 51-52 metro skywalk and sewer, road and pond projects in the villages.

positives.english: Metro skywalk between Sector 51 and 52 is open now, easier to reach the station
positives.hindi: सेक्टर-51 और 52 के बीच मेट्रो स्काईवॉक खुल गया, आना-जाना आसान
positives.basis: Rs 36.90 crore skywalk linking the Sector-52 Blue Line and Sector-51 Aqua Line metro stations; trial opening in August 2026, formal inauguration reported 4 Oct 2026 (Amar Ujala). Sector 51-52 is in Noida city, which the AC Wikipedia extent covers ('It consists of the city of Noida').

positives.english: Foundation stone for sewer work in Chhajarsi and Baraula has been laid
positives.hindi: छजारसी और बरौला में सीवर का शिलान्यास हो गया
positives.basis: Foundation stones laid 14 May 2026 (Do Took Media): Rs 165.13 lakh sewer maintenance work in Chhajarsi with a 1,280 m sewer line in three lanes; Rs 978.68 lakh for a 10 MLD sewage sump well in Baraula. The article gives no completion date. Chhajarsi and Baraula are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

positives.english: Road and drain work worth Rs 4.23 crore has started in Chhajarsi and Chotpur
positives.hindi: छजारसी और चोटपुर में 4.23 करोड़ की सड़क-नाली का काम शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: About Rs 4.23 crore for 16 road and drain projects in Chhajarsi, Chotpur, Bahlolpur and Garhi Chaukhandi, funded from MLA fund, Accelerated Economic Development Scheme and Rajya Sabha MP fund. The article says foundation stones were laid and projects inaugurated, without saying which ones; completion status unconfirmed. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

positives.english: A Rs 9.82 crore pond is being built in Sorkha, half the work is done
positives.hindi: सोरखा में 9.82 करोड़ का तालाब बन रहा है, आधा काम हो गया
positives.basis: Pushkaneer pond in village Sorkha Jahidabad, cost about Rs 9.82 crore, about 50% of work complete, expected to finish in about four months; aim is water conservation and groundwater recharge (UP Ki Baat, page dated 11 Aug 2026). Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

positives.english: The panchayat ghar in Naya Bans village, Sector 15, is built and ready
positives.hindi: सेक्टर-15 के नया बांस गांव में पंचायत घर बनकर तैयार हो गया
positives.basis: New panchayat ghar in Naya Bans village, Sector 15, Noida, inaugurated on a Saturday reported 12 Sep 2026 (Chetna Manch). The article gives two costs, about Rs 230.86 lakh and about Rs 328.78 lakh for the building, and does not reconcile them. Sector 15 is in Noida city (AC extent: 'It consists of the city of Noida'); Naya Bans is not named in the Wikipedia list.

negatives.english: Sorkha's sewer line has not started in 20 years, and roads flood in rain
negatives.hindi: सोरखा में 20 साल से सीवर लाइन शुरू नहीं, बारिश में सड़कें डूबतीं
negatives.basis: Sorkha village, Sector-115 Noida (Amar Ujala, 30 Apr 2026): without a sewer line, light rain floods main roads; Bharatiya Kisan Union Kranti state president warned of agitation and called the authority's chaupal a formality. Amar Ujala video (3 Jan 2025): villagers say a sewer line laid about 20 years ago has still not started, and the main road is too damaged for sanitation tankers. The two sources describe the sewer situation differently (no line vs. laid but not started); the statement follows the video. Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: In the Chhajarsi-Chotpur floodplain, hundreds of power connections were cut, we want 24-hour power
negatives.hindi: छजारसी-चोटपुर के डूब क्षेत्र में सैकड़ों कनेक्शन काट दिए, 24 घंटे बिजली चाहिए
negatives.basis: ETV Bharat (1 Sep 2026): residents of the Chijarsi, Chotpur and Behlolpur floodplain say hundreds of connections were cut over the past four days; they demand 24-hour power and permanent meters. The electricity department gave no statement in the article. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: Sector 43 water supply keeps stopping, sewer blockages during monsoon
negatives.hindi: सेक्टर-43 में पानी बार-बार बंद, बारिश में सीवर जाम हो जाते हैं
negatives.basis: ThePrint ground report (28 Dec 2025): frequent water supply disruptions left entire blocks dry for hours; sewage blockages spread during the monsoon; streetlights stayed broken until a complaint was made. The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 43 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent ('It consists of the city of Noida').

negatives.english: During a VIP visit, the jam from Mahamaya flyover to Sector 51 lasted for hours
negatives.hindi: वीआईपी दौरे पर महामाया फ्लाईओवर से सेक्टर-51 तक घंटों जाम लगा
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (24 Sep 2026): VIP movement in the city caused jams from Mahamaya Flyover to Sector 51, also Dalit Prerna Sthal, Chilla Border and Sector 37 to 51; peak jams 7-10 am and 4-9 pm. One dated event; 'whenever VIPs pass' is not established. TNP News (16 Sep 2026) is an election-framed piece on the 2027 polls; used only for its statement that traffic and parking have long been a local issue in the Noida seat. Noida city is covered by the AC extent.

negatives.english: Drains in Sector 31 are open and water collects
negatives.hindi: सेक्टर-31 में नाले खुले पड़े हैं और पानी भरता है
negatives.basis: Review meeting at Sector-27 club (Do Took Media, 1 Apr 2026): officials were directed to cover drains in Sector 31, clear waterlogging and clean the UGR in C-Block of Sector-31. The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 31 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent.

round2.changes: Re-verified all 14 unique URLs (incl. Wikipedia AC and list pages) against fetched text. Fixed: Baraula 10 MLD facility is a sewage sump well, not pumping station; Naya Bans cost now shows both figures; Sorkha sewer statement corrected (line laid ~20 yrs ago, not started, rather than 'no line'); removed unsourced claim that power dept blamed theft; power-cut Hindi no longer says 'now no 24-hour power' (source says residents demand it); VIP-jam statement no longer says 'whenever'; Sector 43 statement no longer says sewers 'stay blocked'; road-drain statement changed from 'going on' to 'started' with completion unconfirmed; pond Hindi shortened to fit word limit. Re-ranked positives (sewer 2, roads 3, pond 4) and negatives (power 2, Sector 43 water 3, traffic 4). Dadri AC 62 page checked: names Surajpur (Greater Noida), Bisrakh villages, Dadri; does not name Greater Noida West, Sorkha, Chhajarsi, Chotpur or any Noida sector, so these stay in AC 61 per the Wikipedia list and extent.

notes: AC identity confirmed from Wikipedia UP constituency list: No. 61, Noida, district Gautam Budh Nagar, reserved None. Noida AC Wikipedia extent names Raghunathpur, Sorkha Jahidabad, Chhajarsi, Parthala Khanjarpur, Chotpur, Mamura, Gejha Tilpatabad, Chhalera Bangar, Jalpura, Sadarpur, Salarpur Noida, Sultanpur, Baraula, Bhangel Begampur, plus 'other parts of Noida' and says it 'consists of the city of Noida'. Dadri AC 62 (Wikipedia) covers Dadri, Bisrakh-block villages and Surajpur (Greater Noida); Greater Noida West is not named there or in the Noida AC. Sector-level items (Sectors 15, 31, 43, 51-52, 115) and Naya Bans are not named in either Wikipedia page; their AC membership rests on the 'city of Noida' line and no source names the seat for them, so a field check is advisable. Sorkha video is from Jan 2025 (older); the Apr 2026 article shows the problem persists. TNP News is election-framed and used only for one background line. Excluded earlier: Nagla Jahanu and Tirthali (Yamuna City/Jewar side, not in extent), Sector 130/Nangli Wajidpur sewer work (AC membership unconfirmed), an unattributed 50,000-people ncrkhabar figure, and an undated Chhajarsi drain report. Positives are mostly project launches or unconfirmed completion; only the metro skywalk and Naya Bans panchayat ghar are clearly delivered. MLA-linked works are described without naming politicians in the statements.
